newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares poised for recovery echoing Dow rise.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares poised for recovery echoing Dow rise.

text.p: Danish share prices opened unchanged on Wednesday, with dealers seeing modest recovery ahead after Tuesday's fall in the wake of the overnight Dow Jones rise in New York.
"Yesterday's U.S. consumer confidence and employment cost data had a positive efect on the Dow, so we can expect moderate rises here," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index opened at 188.46 at 0700 GMT, having closed 2.14 point lower on Tuesday, hit by profit-taking.
